matrix.rounding_derivation: Each axis pass has 9 weighted signed loads, absolute coefficient sum 1; <=18 FP32 operations gives gamma18. At most 4 passes for 8 steps gives (1+gamma18)^4-1 for |x|<=1. FP16 inputs convert exactly; dyadic coefficients and <=4 passes stay far above FP32 underflow. This bounds arithmetic only, not memory/runtime correctness.
matrix.scope: Full discrete axis-size domain for the modeled linear operators. Two-dimensional equivalence follows from commuting row/column operators; four/eight-step composition checked separately from runtime.

cpu_audit.method: Independent repeated 3x3 FP64 update with zero exterior reapplied at every step; separate integer operator identity covers every legal axis length.
